moves.name: Dire Hit +
moves.description: Raises the user’s critical-hit rate by 2 stat ranks.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: The user gets ready to attack. Using this move again will cause the user to leave this posture, then attack. No other actions can be taken while ready to attack. The preparation period is skipped when the weather is sunny, and the user will attack right away.

moves.name: Expand the Land!
moves.description: Raises the user’s Attack and Sp. Atk by 2 stat ranks. Lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def by 1 stat rank. In addition, raises the user’s Attack and accuracy by 1 stat rank when the weather is sunny. Applies the Supereffective ↑ Next effect to the user when the weather is sunny.

passives.name: Hoenn Pride
passives.description: Powers up the physical attack moves of all allied sync pairs by 20%. Reduces physical attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 25%. The more allied sync pairs with the Hoenn theme you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by 15% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 50%, and the maximum damage reduction is 31%.)

passives.name: Sunburst

passives.name: Solar Surge 3

passives.name: Drought Alert 5
